<module id="multi_pipe_8bit">
    <description>Unsigned 8-bit multiplier based on pipelining processing.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal used for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal. Defined as 0 for chip reset and 1 for reset signal inactive.</input>
        <input id="mul_en_in">Input enable signal that controls the multiplication operation.</input>
        <input id="mul_a" width_description="[7:0]">Input signal representing the multiplicand with a data width of 8 bits.</input>
        <input id="mul_b" width_description="[7:0]">Input signal representing the multiplier with a data width of 8 bits.</input>
        <output id="mul_en_out">Output enable signal indicating if the multiplication operation is enabled.</output>
        <output id="mul_out" width_description="[15:0]">Product output signal with a data width of 16 bits.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter name="IDLE"/>
        <parameter name="LOAD"/>
        <parameter name="MULTIPLY"/>
        <parameter name="ADD"/>
        <parameter name="WIDTH" value="8"/>
        <parameter name="PRODUCT_WIDTH" value="16"/>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <register id="mul_en_out_reg" width="1" initial_value="0"/>
        <register id="mul_a_reg" width="8" initial_value="0"/>
        <register id="mul_b_reg" width="8" initial_value="0"/>
        <register id="partial_product" width="16" initial_value="0"/>
        <register id="sum" width="16" initial_value="0"/>
        <register id="mul_out_reg" width="16" initial_value="0"/>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                mul_en_out_reg <= 0;
                mul_a_reg <= 0;
                mul_b_reg <= 0;
                partial_product <= 0;
                sum <= 0;
                mul_out_reg <= 0;
            end else begin
                case (current_state)
                    IDLE: begin
                        mul_en_out_reg <= mul_en_in;
                        if (mul_en_in) begin
                            mul_a_reg <= mul_a;
                            mul_b_reg <= mul_b;
                            current_state <= LOAD;
                        end
                    end
                    LOAD: begin
                        current_state <= MULTIPLY;
                    end
                    MULTIPLY: begin
                        partial_product <= mul_a_reg * mul_b_reg[0];
                        for (int i = 1; i < WIDTH; i++) begin
                            partial_product += mul_a_reg * mul_b_reg[i] << i;
                        end
                        sum <= partial_product;
                        current_state <= ADD;
                    end
                    ADD: begin
                        mul_out_reg <= sum;
                        current_state <= IDLE;
                    end
                endcase
            end
        end

        assign mul_en_out = mul_en_out_reg[0];
        assign mul_out = mul_out_reg;
    </implementation>
</module>
